description: C8 error and negative behaviour. The shared hosts are only read / POSTed to. Fault injection (upstream 500, database down) runs against a disposable local m9m.

cases.name: C8 malformed JSON is rejected with the same status on both hosts
cases.notes: n8n answers 422 with a V8 parser hint, m9m answers 422 with a Go parser hint; the comparator treats the two hints as the same failure.

cases.name: C8 db_quiry without the required db_type parameter
cases.notes: No expected status is pinned: the contract is that both hosts answer the same way. n8n answers 200 with a structured NodeOperationError, m9m answers 500 with a plain text error - a real m9m-side parity gap.

cases.name: C8 upstream HTTP failure is surfaced as a server error, not a crash
cases.notes: The HTTP Request node points at a closed loopback port. n8n acknowledges the webhook with HTTP 200 and records the upstream failure on the execution; m9m must do the same and must stay healthy (healthz 200). The n8n counterpart fixture cannot be created without mutating the shared n8n.

cases.name: C8 database outage is surfaced as a server error, not a crash
cases.notes: The PostgreSQL node points at a closed loopback port, so the connection fails. The webhook is acknowledged with HTTP 200, the database outage is recorded as a failed execution and m9m stays healthy.
